featured.title: Seoul ‘fabricated” landmine blast, North Korea tells UN in letter
featured.summary: North Korea sent a letter to the United Nations Security Council accusing Seoul of fabricating a landmine explosion that injured three South Korean soldiers, its state media reported Monday. Tensions between the two Koreas have soared since the South last month blamed the blast inside the heavily fortified demilitarised zone that separates the countries on landmines laid by the North, an accusation it has fiercely rejected. The North Korean permanent representative to the UN sent a letter on...

featured.titleZh: 朝鲜致信联合国，称首尔“捏造”地雷爆炸事件
featured.summaryZh: 朝鲜向联合国安理会致信，指责韩国捏造了导致三名韩国士兵受伤的地雷爆炸事件。此前韩国将该事件归咎于朝鲜在非军事区埋设地雷，朝鲜对此予以强烈否认。
featured.whyImportant: 此举加剧了朝鲜半岛本已紧张的局势，并引发了关于非军事区安全与外交指控的国际关注。

featured.title: Trump escalates attacks on Michigan Senate hopeful El-Sayed with 9/11 comparison
featured.summary: US President President Donald Trump at a Sunday campaign rally ratcheted up his push to link US Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed to Muslim extremists, comparing him to the 9/11 attackers while saying Democrats would let violent anti-American terrorists into the United States. “I’m here to keep a jihadist, Muslim Brotherhood member from becoming a United States senator,” the president told a receptive audience in Port Huron, which is in a Michigan area where 66 per cent of the vote went to Trump...
tags: 专题·军事、安全与突发事件
featured.titleZh: 特朗普升级对密歇根州参议院候选人埃尔-赛义德的攻击，将其与9/11事件相提并论
featured.summaryZh: 美国总统特朗普在竞选集会上将参议院候选人阿卜杜勒·埃尔-赛义德与9/11袭击者联系起来，并指责民主党人会允许恐怖分子进入美国。此举旨在通过激烈的言辞动员选民。
featured.whyImportant: 此类言论加剧了美国政治中的身份政治对立，并对选举氛围产生了显著影响。

featured.title: Man falls to death fleeing Hong Kong police raid on suspected drug den
featured.summary: A man has died after falling from a building while trying to flee a Hong Kong police raid on a suspected drug den in Yau Ma Tei. The 42-year-old man, surnamed Kwong, was found unconscious outside 385-387 Reclamation Street at about 9.28pm on Sunday. He was rushed to Kwong Wah Hospital, where he was pronounced dead, police said on Monday. featured.titleZh: 男子逃避香港警方突击搜查疑似毒窟时坠楼身亡
featured.summaryZh: 一名42岁男子在油麻地一栋大厦内，为逃避警方对疑似毒窟的突击搜查而坠楼。该男子被送往广华医院后证实不治身亡。
featured.whyImportant: 该事件反映了香港警方在打击毒品犯罪行动中面临的突发安全挑战。

Andre McKechnie sued Victoria’s corrections department after he was refused the salty, yeast-based condiment in prison. Continue reading...

featured.titleZh: 法院驳回澳大利亚囚犯诉求，称食用Vegemite酱并非人权
featured.summaryZh: 一名被判谋杀罪的囚犯声称监狱禁止提供Vegemite酱侵犯了他享受文化的人权，但法院驳回了其诉求。法院裁定，监狱内禁止食用这种咸味酵母酱的规定依然有效。
featured.whyImportant: 该裁决明确了囚犯在监狱内享有的权利范围，并确认了惩教部门对监狱内食品供应的监管权。

featured.summary: Victorian coroner hears Emily Lal told Stacey Warnecke that her ‘condition and mindset’ needed to be ‘solid’ to avoid a hospital birth A birthkeeper who allegedly “groomed” pregnant women to fear hospital could be referred to prosecutors to face potential criminal charges, a Victorian coroner has heard. Stacey Warnecke died in September 2025 at Frankston hospital in Melbourne after giving birth at home and suffering a postpartum haemorrhage with birthkeeper Emily Lal by her side, having paid her $6,000 to support her throughout pregnancy. featured.titleZh: 涉嫌诱导孕妇恐惧医院的“助产士”可能面临刑事指控
featured.summaryZh: 维多利亚州验尸官获悉，一名助产士曾诱导孕妇恐惧医院生产，导致一名产妇在家中分娩后因产后出血死亡。目前该助产士可能被移交检察机关，面临刑事指控。
featured.whyImportant: 此案引发了关于非医疗专业人员在分娩过程中所扮演角色及其法律责任的广泛讨论。

featured.title: Man bitten after being chased by 3 dogs on his way to work in Yuen Long
featured.summary: A 26-year-old warehouse worker has been injured in Hong Kong after being chased by three dogs and bitten by one of them on his way to work. A source said police received a report at around 8am on Monday from the victim, surnamed Leung, saying one of the dogs pounced on him as he was walking towards his workplace at a logistics company in Yuen Long’s Kam Pok Road. Paramedics arrived at the scene and found the victim with minor wounds. He was sent to Pok Oi Hospital for treatment. The source said...

featured.titleZh: 男子在元朗上班途中遭三只狗追逐并被咬伤
featured.summaryZh: 一名26岁仓库工人在元朗上班途中遭到三只狗追逐，其中一只狗将其咬伤。受害者随后被送往博爱医院接受治疗，伤势较轻。
featured.whyImportant: 此事件引发了公众对社区流浪狗管理及公共安全问题的关注。

featured.titleZh: 美军称已协助海湾国家出口15亿桶石油
featured.summaryZh: 美国中央司令部表示，在美军的支持下，已有超过3000艘商船顺利通过霍尔木兹海峡。此举旨在保障该地区的能源运输安全。

featured.titleZh: 双重谋杀案庭审播放Beau Lamarre-Condon狱中秘密录音
featured.summaryZh: 在悉尼的一场庭审中，播放了一段前警官Beau Lamarre-Condon在狱中与朋友的秘密录音。录音中他承认自己应对朋友卷入此案负责，他被控枪杀了一对情侣。

global.title: Australia politics live: Plibersek notes ‘industrial scale of abuse’ but urges young women not to be turned off entering politics
global.summary: Follow live updates Get our daily political email, free app or daily news podcast Steggall calls for civility and respect Independent MP Zali Steggall has called for more respect in times of disagreement, telling ABC that leadership and words matter. We absolutely need to make sure there is more civility and respect. Social media is a platform where they can send abuse and threats through direct messages, call my electorate office, or send pretty revolting stuff It’s just quite shocking how disconnected from manners and reality sometimes people get when they launch into their diatribes and make threats. There’s been a lot of money and a lot of effort and a lot of thought going into security here at Parliament House. I think the vulnerability is actually when we’re out doing our job in the community, and that’s probably where we need to put the focus. Continue reading...

global.titleZh: 澳大利亚政治动态：Plibersek指出存在“工业规模的虐待”，呼吁女性不要因此放弃从政
global.summaryZh: 针对政界日益严重的网络暴力和威胁，独立议员Zali Steggall呼吁在政治辩论中保持文明与尊重。尽管面临严峻的骚扰环境，政界人士仍鼓励年轻女性积极参与政治。
global.whyImportant: 此讨论反映了澳大利亚政坛在应对网络暴力和保障议员人身安全方面所面临的严峻挑战。

global.titleZh: 深度分裂的以色列严阵以待关键选举
global.summaryZh: 在经历了三年的地区战争后，以色列即将迎来一场至关重要的选举。这场选举被视为该国政治进程中的一个关键转折点。
global.whyImportant: 选举结果将决定以色列未来的政治走向及应对地区安全挑战的策略。

global.title: Why Israel's election is one of the most important in its history
global.summary: Security and democracy emerge as central issues in Israel's highly anticipated general election, as Middle East correspondent Lucy Williamson reports.
tags: 专题·军事、安全与突发事件
global.titleZh: 为何以色列此次选举是其历史上最重要的选举之一
global.summaryZh: 安全与民主已成为以色列此次大选的核心议题。随着选民投票的临近，这些议题将深刻影响该国的未来发展方向。
global.whyImportant: 此次选举不仅关乎以色列的国内政策，也将对中东地区的整体地缘政治格局产生深远影响。

global.title: Hong Kong to tighten burgeoning premium financing market as red flags, risks emerge
global.summary: Hong Kong’s insurance watchdog is tightening oversight of the city’s booming premium financing market, as the once-niche lending arrangement spreads to lower-tier insurance buyers, while also reviewing regulations, particularly on how insurers evaluate clients’ affordability, according to Insurance Authority executives. Premium financing allows policyholders to borrow money from financial institutions to pay upfront premiums on large life insurance policies, which are commonly used as a wealth...
global.titleZh: 香港保险监管机构将收紧保费融资市场，以应对日益凸显的风险
global.summaryZh: 香港保险业监管局正加强对保费融资市场的监管，因该业务已扩展至低端保险买家，引发了对客户偿付能力评估的担忧。监管机构正在审查相关法规，以遏制这一曾属于小众借贷安排的市场所带来的潜在金融风险。
global.whyImportant: 此举旨在防范金融风险，保护保险消费者并维护香港金融市场的稳定性。

global.title: Lula pulls off Brazil’s first-ever run-off comeback to beat Trump ally Flavio Bolsonaro
global.summary: Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva won re-election on Sunday in a dramatic comeback after trailing in the first round, extending the rule of a government that has overseen record Chinese investment. The Superior Electoral Court said Lula had 51.79 per cent of valid votes against 48.21 per cent for right-wing Senator Flavio Bolsonaro, with 99.99 per cent votes counted. No candidate who trailed after the first round had won a run-off since Brazil adopted the system in 1989. Addressing...
global.titleZh: 卢拉实现巴西史上首次决选逆转，击败特朗普盟友弗拉维奥·博索纳罗
global.summaryZh: 巴西总统卢拉在首轮落后的情况下实现戏剧性逆转，成功连任。这是巴西自1989年采用现行选举制度以来，首次有候选人在首轮落后后赢得决选。
global.whyImportant: 此次选举结果将延续现任政府的政策，并可能对巴西与中国的经贸关系产生持续影响。

china.summary: An AI-generated Chinese rap song featuring some of the country’s most well-known historical figures has taken social media by storm. china.titleZh: 播放量破亿：中国AI说唱歌曲为何能引发共鸣？
china.summaryZh: 一首由人工智能创作的中国说唱歌曲《过来人》在两周内播放量突破一亿次。该曲通过融合历史人物与现代生活焦虑，精准触动了当代听众的情感共鸣。
china.whyImportant: 该现象展示了AI技术在文化创作领域的潜力，以及社会大众对表达现代生活压力的文化产品的需求。

china.titleZh: 香港仲裁机构着眼于中东和非洲市场，以应对全球紧张局势
china.summaryZh: 香港国际仲裁中心正积极拓展中东和非洲业务，利用香港的中立性和可预测性吸引海外企业。随着全球商业增长重心向亚洲转移，更多国际企业倾向于选择香港作为争议解决地。
china.whyImportant: 这有助于巩固香港作为国际法律及争议解决中心的地位，并促进其在多元化市场中的影响力。

china.title: Xi Jinping’s corruption crackdown in the spotlight as China prepares for meeting of top leaders
china.summary: The fifth plenum comes against a backdrop of years of purges that have had some analysts wondering if the issue is corruption or a lack of loyalty When Xi Jinping came to power in 2012, he pledged to stamp out corruption all through the ranks of the Communist party. More than a decade later, the pace of investigations has not slowed. Last year, China’s disciplinary authorities opened investigations into more than 1 million people, including more than 100 officials at or above ministerial or provincial level. As Chinese Communist party (CCP) officials kick off an important meeting this week, discipline – and party loyalty – is high on the agenda. For those who try to read the tea leaves of elite Chinese politics, concern about the apparent lack of discipline is dominating CCP discussions. Continue reading...
china.titleZh: 中国高层会议前夕，习近平的反腐行动备受关注
china.summaryZh: 在中共五中全会召开之际，反腐败与党内纪律再次成为核心议题。过去一年中，中国纪检部门调查了超过一百万名官员，显示出反腐力度并未减弱。
china.whyImportant: 反腐工作的持续推进对中国政治生态及党内纪律建设具有深远影响。

watch.summary: The debate over ethnic identity in Xinjiang has triggered an online clash between Chinese and Turkish social media users. The row began earlier this month when a Turkish social media user recalled an encounter with a Uygur from Xinjiang, the region in China that is home to nearly 12 million mainly Muslim Turkic speakers. The user wrote that the woman did not look Chinese, but when asked whether she considered herself Turkic, the woman responded: “No, I’m Chinese.” The user also called on her to...

watch.summaryZh: 近期，一名土耳其社交媒体用户分享了与一名新疆维吾尔族女性的对话，引发了关于民族认同的在线争论。该事件导致中土两国网民在社交平台上展开了激烈的观点交锋。
watch.whyImportant: 该事件凸显了跨文化交流中关于民族身份认同的敏感性，以及社交媒体在放大地缘政治议题讨论中的作用。

watch.summary: Venezuela’s opposition leader and Nobel Peace Prize winner Maria Corina Machado returned home after more than 10 months.

watch.summary: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said that Iran and its allies might try to disrupt Tuesday’s Israeli elections, warning the Islamic republic against any hostile acts. The remarks came as Israel’s Channel 12 reported, citing unnamed sources, that there had been a confrontation between Netanyahu and army chief Eyal Zamir over an unspecified new directive in the war with Iran, which the prime minister denied. Netanyahu has campaigned heavily on his security credentials, touting the war he...

watch.titleZh: 内塔尼亚胡警告伊朗可能试图干扰以色列大选：“不要考验我们”

more.title: China’s Liaoning carrier and USS Theodore Roosevelt may be in Philippine Sea at same time
more.summary: China’s Liaoning aircraft carrier strike group sailed beyond the first island chain last week to reach the southernmost waters of the Philippines, suggesting an intent to position itself closer to ongoing US-Japan joint exercises. Philippine news channel BNC reported that the carrier group reached about 25 nautical miles (46km) east-southeast of Balut Island, the southernmost point of the Philippines, before sailing northeast on Friday. That positioned the warships past the first island chain, a...

more.titleZh: 中国辽宁舰航母编队与美国罗斯福号航母可能同时出现在菲律宾海
more.summaryZh: 中国辽宁舰航母编队近期航行至菲律宾最南端海域，位置靠近美日联合演习区域。外界分析认为，此举显示中国海军正加强在第一岛链外的军事存在。
more.whyImportant: 中美两国航母编队在敏感海域的潜在近距离接触，增加了区域军事对峙的风险。

items.title: Seoul ‘fabricated” landmine blast, North Korea tells UN in letter
items.summary: North Korea sent a letter to the United Nations Security Council accusing Seoul of fabricating a landmine explosion that injured three South Korean soldiers, its state media reported Monday. items.titleZh: 朝鲜致信联合国，称首尔“捏造”地雷爆炸事件
items.summaryZh: 朝鲜向联合国安理会致信，指责韩国捏造了导致三名韩国士兵受伤的地雷爆炸事件。此前韩国将该事件归咎于朝鲜在非军事区埋设地雷，朝鲜对此予以强烈否认。
items.whyImportant: 此举加剧了朝鲜半岛本已紧张的局势，并引发了关于非军事区安全与外交指控的国际关注。

items.whyImportant: 该事件反映了香港警方在打击毒品犯罪行动中面临的突发安全挑战。

items.summary: Prohibition of salty, yeast-based condiment in Victoria’s prisons remains after convicted murderer claimed it denied him right to ‘enjoy his culture’ Follow our Australia politics live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast A murderer who claimed a refusal to allow him Vegemite in prison is a breach of his human rights as an Australian has failed to overturn the ban on the polarising spread. items.whyImportant: 该裁决明确了囚犯在监狱内享有的权利范围，并确认了惩教部门对监狱内食品供应的监管权。

items.title: Birthkeeper who allegedly ‘groomed’ pregnant women to fear hospital could face criminal charges
items.summary: Victorian coroner hears Emily Lal told Stacey Warnecke that her ‘condition and mindset’ needed to be ‘solid’ to avoid a hospital birth A birthkeeper who allegedly “groomed” pregnant women to fear hospital could be referred to prosecutors to face potential criminal charges, a Victorian coroner has heard. Stacey Warnecke died in September 2025 at Frankston hospital in Melbourne after giving birth at home and suffering a postpartum haemorrhage with birthkeeper Emily Lal by her side, having paid her $6,000 to support her throughout pregnancy. Paramedics arrived at the scene and found the victim with minor wounds. He was sent to Pok Oi Hospital for treatment. The source said...

items.summaryZh: 在悉尼的一场庭审中，播放了一段前警官Beau Lamarre-Condon在狱中与朋友的秘密录音。录音中他承认自己应对朋友卷入此案负责，他被控枪杀了一对情侣。

items.title: Australia politics live: Plibersek notes ‘industrial scale of abuse’ but urges young women not to be turned off entering politics
items.summary: Follow live updates Get our daily political email, free app or daily news podcast Steggall calls for civility and respect Independent MP Zali Steggall has called for more respect in times of disagreement, telling ABC that leadership and words matter. Social media is a platform where they can send abuse and threats through direct messages, call my electorate office, or send pretty revolting stuff It’s just quite shocking how disconnected from manners and reality sometimes people get when they launch into their diatribes and make threats. items.titleZh: 香港保险监管机构将收紧保费融资市场，以应对日益凸显的风险

items.title: Lula pulls off Brazil’s first-ever run-off comeback to beat Trump ally Flavio Bolsonaro

items.titleZh: 卢拉实现巴西史上首次决选逆转，击败特朗普盟友弗拉维奥·博索纳罗

items.title: 100 million views: why China’s viral AI rap track has struck a chord

items.titleZh: 香港仲裁机构着眼于中东和非洲市场，以应对全球紧张局势
items.summaryZh: 香港国际仲裁中心正积极拓展中东和非洲业务，利用香港的中立性和可预测性吸引海外企业。随着全球商业增长重心向亚洲转移，更多国际企业倾向于选择香港作为争议解决地。
items.whyImportant: 这有助于巩固香港作为国际法律及争议解决中心的地位，并促进其在多元化市场中的影响力。

items.title: Xi Jinping’s corruption crackdown in the spotlight as China prepares for meeting of top leaders
items.summary: The fifth plenum comes against a backdrop of years of purges that have had some analysts wondering if the issue is corruption or a lack of loyalty When Xi Jinping came to power in 2012, he pledged to stamp out corruption all through the ranks of the Communist party. More than a decade later, the pace of investigations has not slowed. Last year, China’s disciplinary authorities opened investigations into more than 1 million people, including more than 100 officials at or above ministerial or provincial level. As Chinese Communist party (CCP) officials kick off an important meeting this week, discipline – and party loyalty – is high on the agenda. For those who try to read the tea leaves of elite Chinese politics, concern about the apparent lack of discipline is dominating CCP discussions. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 中国高层会议前夕，习近平的反腐行动备受关注
items.summaryZh: 在中共五中全会召开之际，反腐败与党内纪律再次成为核心议题。过去一年中，中国纪检部门调查了超过一百万名官员，显示出反腐力度并未减弱。
items.whyImportant: 反腐工作的持续推进对中国政治生态及党内纪律建设具有深远影响。

items.title: 收到 伊朗策划袭击 情报后 ： 美国对中东13国更新旅行警告 ， 多国使馆限制运行|沙特|也门
tags: 专题·军事、安全与突发事件
items.titleZh: 收到伊朗策划袭击情报后：美国对中东13国更新旅行警告，多国使馆限制运行
items.summaryZh: 美国因收到伊朗策划袭击的情报，对中东13个国家发布了更新后的旅行警告。受此影响，美国在当地的多处使馆已采取限制运行措施。
items.whyImportant: 此举反映了中东地区安全局势的紧张升级，可能对区域外交与人员流动产生直接影响。

items.title: War of words over Xinjiang erupts between Chinese and Turkish social media users
items.summary: The debate over ethnic identity in Xinjiang has triggered an online clash between Chinese and Turkish social media users. The row began earlier this month when a Turkish social media user recalled an encounter with a Uygur from Xinjiang, the region in China that is home to nearly 12 million mainly Muslim Turkic speakers. tags: 专题·军事、安全与突发事件
items.titleZh: 中土社交媒体用户就新疆问题爆发口水战
items.summaryZh: 近期，一名土耳其社交媒体用户分享了与一名新疆维吾尔族女性的对话，引发了关于民族认同的在线争论。该事件导致中土两国网民在社交平台上展开了激烈的观点交锋。
items.whyImportant: 该事件凸显了跨文化交流中关于民族身份认同的敏感性，以及社交媒体在放大地缘政治议题讨论中的作用。

items.title: Venezuelan opposition leader María Machado returns after months in exile
items.summary: Venezuela’s opposition leader and Nobel Peace Prize winner Maria Corina Machado returned home after more than 10 months.
items.titleZh: 委内瑞拉反对派领导人玛丽亚·马查多流亡数月后回国
items.summaryZh: 委内瑞拉反对派领导人、诺贝尔和平奖得主玛丽亚·科里纳·马查多在流亡十个多月后返回国内。此次回国引发了外界对委内瑞拉国内政治局势走向的关注。
items.whyImportant: 马查多的回归可能对委内瑞拉国内的政治格局及反对派的后续行动产生重要影响。

items.title: Netanyahu warns Iran may try to disrupt Israel election: ‘don’t test us’
items.summary: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said that Iran and its allies might try to disrupt Tuesday’s Israeli elections, warning the Islamic republic against any hostile acts. The remarks came as Israel’s Channel 12 reported, citing unnamed sources, that there had been a confrontation between Netanyahu and army chief Eyal Zamir over an unspecified new directive in the war with Iran, which the prime minister denied. Netanyahu has campaigned heavily on his security credentials, touting the war he...

items.titleZh: 内塔尼亚胡警告伊朗可能试图干扰以色列大选：“不要考验我们”
items.summaryZh: 以色列总理内塔尼亚胡警告称，伊朗及其盟友可能试图干扰即将到来的以色列大选。此外，有报道称内塔尼亚胡与军方高层在对伊战争指令上存在分歧，但遭到了总理本人的否认。
items.whyImportant: 此番言论加剧了以色列与伊朗之间的紧张关系，并可能影响以色列国内的选举氛围与安全政策讨论。

items.title: China’s Liaoning carrier and USS Theodore Roosevelt may be in Philippine Sea at same time
items.summary: China’s Liaoning aircraft carrier strike group sailed beyond the first island chain last week to reach the southernmost waters of the Philippines, suggesting an intent to position itself closer to ongoing US-Japan joint exercises. Philippine news channel BNC reported that the carrier group reached about 25 nautical miles (46km) east-southeast of Balut Island, the southernmost point of the Philippines, before sailing northeast on Friday. items.titleZh: 中国辽宁舰航母编队与美国罗斯福号航母可能同时出现在菲律宾海
items.summaryZh: 中国辽宁舰航母编队近期航行至菲律宾最南端海域，位置靠近美日联合演习区域。外界分析认为，此举显示中国海军正加强在第一岛链外的军事存在。
items.whyImportant: 中美两国航母编队在敏感海域的潜在近距离接触，增加了区域军事对峙的风险。
